```php
<?php

namespace App\Livewire;

use Livewire\Component;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;

class NoteShowComponent extends Component
{
    public $note;
    public $tags = [];
    public $newTag = '';

    public function mount(Note $note)
    {
        $this->note = $note;
        $this->tags = Auth::user()->notesTags()->get()->pluck('tag_id')->toArray();
    }

    public function updateTag()
    {
        if ($this->newTag) {
            $this->note->tags()->attach($this->newTag);
            $this->newTag = '';
        }
    }

    public function deleteTag(int $tagId)
    {
        $this->note->tags()->detach($tagId);
    }

    public function render()
    {
        return view('livewire.note-show-component');
    }
}
```
